events.description: A man in a green jacket and a person in light clothing engage in physical combat, with visible grappling and striking motions.
Three uniformed figures surround and attack a prone individual on the ground; one figure appears to strike or kick the victim while others stand over them.

One uniformed figure raises a firearm and appears to discharge it toward the prone individual; muzzle flash or recoil is not clearly visible due to pixelation, but posture and arm extension are consistent with firing.
A black van collides with another vehicle (partially visible), producing a cloud of dust/debris and visible impact distortion; the van’s front end appears damaged and it veers sharply.

Large-scale violent unrest in a city square: dense crowd of civilians and armed/colored-uniformed agents engaged in chaotic confrontation; smoke (likely tear gas or stun grenade) erupts near left sidewalk at ~88.0s and persists; multiple individuals are seen falling, running, and clashing across the intersection; green-highlighted units (player faction) actively engage with hostile groups; purple vertical line indicates player aim/crosshair, suggesting active combat control.

Multiple localized physical combats occur simultaneously: individuals in dark clothing grapple and strike others near center-left; green-highlighted units engage in hand-to-hand or close-range weapon use against opponents; visible takedowns and melee clashes persist throughout the sequence.

A sudden white/grey smoke plume erupts from the left sidewalk area at ~88.0s, expanding rapidly over ~0.5s—consistent with a small explosive device (e.g., flashbang or stun grenade) detonation; no fireball, but rapid expansion and displacement of nearby individuals confirm blast event.

Large-scale violent unrest in a city square: multiple groups of individuals engage in coordinated clashes, throwing objects, charging, and forming opposing lines; visible debris on ground, some individuals fallen or prone, and use of non-lethal crowd-control effects (purple/blue area suggesting tear gas or stun effect) centered in the plaza.

Close-quarters physical combat observed among small clusters within the larger riot: individuals grappling, punching, and wrestling, particularly near the center-left and right flanks of the crowd; distinct from general movement due to sustained contact and postures indicating mutual aggression.

A man in a dark jacket runs toward another man standing on the sidewalk and appears to initiate physical contact, consistent with an assault or fight; the second man reacts by raising his arms defensively.
